newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices -March 21.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices -March 21.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker suppliers lowered their offers slightly on Friday amid softer cargo prices, traders said. However, bunker prices remained at high levels and might not be attractive enough for shipowners, they said. A trader was heard to sell a 900-tonne parcel of the 380-cst grade at $101 per tonne. -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3571)
